function world(o: { files?: Record<string, string>; git?: Git; status?: (c: PrepCommand) => number | null; now?: string; tickets?: Record<string, string> } = {}) {
  const files: Record<string, string> = { ...o.files };
  for (const [name, text] of Object.entries(o.tickets ?? {})) files[join(ROOT, 'docs', 'tickets', name)] = text;
  const ran: PrepCommand[] = [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  const err: string[] = [];
  let clock = 0;
  const io: TempoIo = {
    root: ROOT,
    git: o.git ?? (() => ({ status: 1, stdout: '' })),
    run: (c) => {
      ran.push(c);
      clock += 2000;
      return (o.status ?? (() => 0))(c);
    },
    read: (path) => files[path],
    append: (path, text) => void (files[path] = (files[path] ?? '') + text),
    exists: () => false,
    list: (dir) => Object.keys(files).filter((p) => p.startsWith(join(dir, 'x').slice(0, -1))).map((p) => p.slice(dir.length + 1)),
    clock: () => clock,
    now: () => o.now ?? '2026-10-05T12:00:00.000Z',
    out: (text) => void out.push(text),
    err: (text) => void err.push(text),
  };
  return { io, files, ran, out: () => out.join(''), err: () => err.join(''), records: () => parseObservations(files[LOG]) };
